items.html: Therefore the supreme Emanator wished, and drew and enlarged the vessel of Keter, which did not break, as is known, and it was drawn through the middle line, as stated, for the GR had already been from the outset in the form of three lines, and it was drawn through the middle line down to the place of Tifferet, only to its middle, that is, only down to the navel. Then the light of Tifferet rose and was hidden within the aforesaid vessel of Keter, which had expanded down to its place. Thus only the lower half of the light of Tifferet was raised, for the upper half remained in its place, since the vessel of Keter had already expanded through it. Then the light of Da'at, which had descended below into Malchut of Atzilut, seeing that a new vessel already existed in its place — for its place too is in the middle line between Keter and Tifferet — it too then rose and ascended into its place. Then its vessel, since the light had moved away from it, descended down to Malchut of Beria; however, the vessel of Tifferet remained in its place, which is in Keter of Beria, since not all of its light was raised but only its half, and its upper half remained in its place.
